'''Teychenne''' was the [[Spy/Legends|Spymaster]] of [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Purton]] of [[Concord Dawn/Legends|Concord Dawn]]. After losing his son [[Lenovar]] to a killer by the name of "Jaster Mereel," the governor decided to exact revenge on his son's murderer. Teychenne was able to unearth Mereel's background, discovering that he was the famous [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]]. She was also able to locate his loved ones, [[Sintas Vel|Sintas]] and [[Ailyn Vel]], and [[Connor Freeman]]. After Purton's failed attempt on Fett and his family's lives, and subsequent death, Fett declared that Teychenne was to work for him.
